adjudication.rationale: In `sendAddGuestsEmails` the template selection is based on `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` (case-sensitive) without lowercasing either side. Since `addGuests.handler.ts` passes `guests` through as provided (no normalization) and attendee emails may not match casing, a guest email like `A@x.com` vs stored `a@x.com` would not be recognized as “new” and would result in the wrong email template being sent.
